items.title: 2.9.1.5 Opening, Reading, and Closing Files (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of reading files (PDF 62).

blocks.text: File parhne ke liye usay open() function se kholein, us ka mawaad (contents) parhein aur phir file band karein ta ke computer ke resources azaad hon.

# Open and read a file
with open("example.txt", "r") as file:
    content = file.read ()
    print(content)

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein yeh code bikhra hua chhapa hai: line ke tukre do columns mein hain aur andar ki do lines margin par hain. Oopar tukre sahi tarteeb mein, aur with ke andar wali lines indented hain.

items: with statement yaqeeni banata hai ke kaam khatam hote hi file band ho jaye, chahe beech mein ghalti aa jaye.
File read mode ("r") mein khulti hai, read() se sara mawaad content mein aata hai, phir print hota hai.
with se kholi gayi file khud ba khud band ho jati hai; close() likhne ki zaroorat nahi.

blocks.title: Dhyan dein
blocks.text: example.txt pehle se maujood honi chahiye, warna FileNotFoundError aata hai.

blocks.prompt: open("example.txt", "r") mein "r" ka kya matlab hai?
blocks.explanation: Read mode: file sirf parhne ke liye khulti hai aur pehle se maujood honi chahiye.

items: with open("file", "r") as f: content = f.read(); file khud band hoti hai.
